space.titleA: I build software from the ground up
space.lead: I'm Jesus Liang, Fullstack Lead at Availroom. I design, build and ship SaaS products with TypeScript, React, Node.js, AWS and AI.
space.concept: This site is the journey in reverse: it goes down layer by layer, from what is already in orbit to the foundations that hold it up.

milestones.text: Migrated a monolithic jQuery social network to a React SPA, step by step and without breaking the PHP backend.
The real-time PMS, the smart-lock check-in app and the white-label booking engine.
I lead the team: architecture, CI/CD and AWS. Omnichannel platform with AI, predictive CRM and the move to microservices.

city.aboutTitle: Over five years turning ideas into products.
city.aboutText: Since 2020 I've been building software real people use every day: real-time interfaces, hardware integrations, widgets that run inside other people's websites and AI agents in production. I've gone from writing components to leading a team, and what I enjoy most is the whole cycle: deciding how something gets built, building it, shipping it and seeing how it behaves in the real world. I work remotely.

ai.title: Omnichannel platform with AI agents
ai.summary: Every guest message in one real-time inbox, with PMS-connected AI agents that translate, look up bookings and take action.
ai.challenge: Property managers talk to guests from all over the world through WhatsApp, email and the OTAs, and most replies require checking or changing something in the PMS: rates, cleanings, arrival times.
built: Designed an end-to-end real-time omnichannel platform that unifies every conversation.
Integrated PMS-connected AI agents that automate operational workflows such as rates and cleanings.
Instant translation and contextual replies using each booking's data.

pms.title: PMS / Channel Manager
pms.summary: The platform 150+ property managers run on every day: a desktop inside the browser with real-time multi-user collaboration.
pms.challenge: Managers juggle dozens of properties and several channels, and their teams edit the same bookings at the same time. They needed a tool as fast as a desktop app where nobody overwrites anybody else's work.
built: A desktop-style interface with windows and apps, built with React and Redux using memoized selectors (Reselect) to avoid wasted renders.
A Node.js and Express WebSocket microservice for Figma- or Google Docs-style real-time collaboration.
As Lead, I coordinated the gradual migration of the core to microservices.

booking.title: White-label booking engine
booking.summary: A widget any hotel or property manager embeds in their own site to sell direct, with their brand and an experience on par with Booking or Airbnb.
booking.challenge: Every client runs a different website: WordPress, templates or custom builds. It had to deliver a complete booking flow that fits all of them, carries each client's brand and needs no coding on their side.
built: A modular, high-performance engine in React and TypeScript.
Bundled with Webpack so it can be injected into any third-party site, from web apps to WordPress.
Search, filters, map, pricing and checkout wired to PMS availability.

checkin.title: Digital check-in with smart locks
checkin.summary: Guests check in from their phone, identify themselves with a photo of their document and open the door without keys.
checkin.challenge: Handing over keys and collecting documents in person doesn't scale across thousands of properties. The whole process had to work from the guest's phone.
built: A web check-in flow with the booking details and useful property information.
Integration of an OCR SDK that extracts data from ID cards, passports and driver's licenses from a photo.
Smart-lock integration to open the building and the door from the app.

crm.title: Predictive CRM
crm.summary: A CRM built from scratch that integrates market APIs to forecast vacation rental performance and speed up the acquisition team.
crm.challenge: The acquisition team needed to decide quickly which properties to onboard and on what terms, without living in spreadsheets.
built: Led the development of the CRM from scratch.
Integrated third-party APIs that forecast vacation rental performance.
Contract generation for the acquisition team.

leaderslinked.title: Leaders Linked
leaderslinked.summary: Migrating a monolithic jQuery and PHP professional social network to a React SPA without stopping the service.
leaderslinked.challenge: The social network was a PHP monolith with jQuery. The frontend had to be modernised without a big-bang rewrite that would halt the product.
built: Refactored the interface into a React SPA.
Configured Webpack for a gradual transition on top of the PHP backend.
Finally decoupled the frontend from the backend.
